description: Delegate a task to a sub-agent with a specific profile. The agent runs autonomously. Built-in agent definitions: @standard/main (general-purpose default), @standard/explorer (read-only codebase questions), @standard/worker (execution subtask with explicit ownership). Parent contract: the sub-agent links under the calling execution, so cancelling the caller stops a spawned sub-agent and hierarchy depth limits apply to the chain. A call issued outside any live execution runs the sub-agent as a root.
name: call_agent

agent_id.description: The agent definition ID to invoke

agent_profile_id.description: The agent profile ID to invoke

available_tool_names.description: Tool names the agent may call; empty means all tools

conversation.description: Initial conversation imported into the agent session

file_scope.description: Optional execution filesystem scope override (enabled, read_prefixes, write_prefixes, checkpoint_prefixes, workdir); missing inherits parent then global

hooks.description: Hooks to attach to the agent loop

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of agent loop iterations

prompt.description: The task prompt for the agent

token_limit.description: Cumulative token limit for the agent conversation

token_warning_threshold.description: Warning threshold percentage of the token limit

tool_call_protocol.description: Protocol lock for tool calls (e.g. XML wrapping)

wait.description: Whether to wait for the agent to complete
